access_sessions_end_consistent.name: access_sessions_end_consistent
access_sessions_end_consistent.value: ("access_sessions"."ended_at" IS NULL) = ("access_sessions"."end_reason" IS NULL) AND ("access_sessions"."ended_at" IS NULL OR "access_sessions"."ended_at" >= "access_sessions"."started_at")

appointment_reminders_sent_complete.name: appointment_reminders_sent_complete
appointment_reminders_sent_complete.value: "appointment_reminders"."status" <> 'sent' OR ("appointment_reminders"."message_id" IS NOT NULL AND "appointment_reminders"."via" IS NOT NULL)

appointments_notes_len.name: appointments_notes_len
appointments_notes_len.value: "appointments"."notes" IS NULL OR length("appointments"."notes") BETWEEN 1 AND 1000

appointments_cancel_consistent.name: appointments_cancel_consistent
appointments_cancel_consistent.value: ("appointments"."status" = 'cancelled') = ("appointments"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL AND "appointments"."cancelled_by" IS NOT NULL AND "appointments"."cancel_reason" IS NOT NULL)

business_hours_scope_valid.name: business_hours_scope_valid
business_hours_scope_valid.value: ("business_hours"."scope" = 'org' AND "business_hours"."queue_id" IS NULL) OR ("business_hours"."scope" = 'queue' AND "business_hours"."queue_id" IS NOT NULL)

companies_website_len.name: companies_website_len
companies_website_len.value: "companies"."website" IS NULL OR length("companies"."website") BETWEEN 1 AND 200

companies_email_len.name: companies_email_len
companies_email_len.value: "companies"."email" IS NULL OR length("companies"."email") BETWEEN 3 AND 254

contact_lists_columns_array.name: contact_lists_columns_array
contact_lists_columns_array.value: "contact_lists"."columns" IS NULL OR (jsonb_typeof("contact_lists"."columns") = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length("contact_lists"."columns") BETWEEN 1 AND 40)

contacts_email_shape.name: contacts_email_shape
contacts_email_shape.value: "contacts"."email" IS NULL OR ("contacts"."email" = lower("contacts"."email") AND length("contacts"."email") <= 254 AND "contacts"."email" ~ '^[^[:space:]@]+@[^[:space:]@]+[.][^[:space:]@]{2,}$')

contacts_ctwa_cl_id_shape.name: contacts_ctwa_cl_id_shape
contacts_ctwa_cl_id_shape.value: "contacts"."ctwa_cl_id" IS NULL OR length(btrim("contacts"."ctwa_cl_id")) BETWEEN 1 AND 500

contacts_touch_source_shape.name: contacts_touch_source_shape
contacts_touch_source_shape.value: ("contacts"."first_touch_source" IS NULL OR "contacts"."first_touch_source" ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{1,31}$') AND ("contacts"."last_touch_source" IS NULL OR "contacts"."last_touch_source" ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{1,31}$')

custom_field_definitions_options_by_type.name: custom_field_definitions_options_by_type
custom_field_definitions_options_by_type.value: ("custom_field_definitions"."type" IN ('select', 'multiselect') AND "custom_field_definitions"."options" IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof("custom_field_definitions"."options") = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length("custom_field_definitions"."options") BETWEEN 1 AND 50) OR ("custom_field_definitions"."type" NOT IN ('select', 'multiselect') AND "custom_field_definitions"."options" IS NULL)

message_attachments_filename_len.name: message_attachments_filename_len
message_attachments_filename_len.value: "message_attachments"."filename" IS NULL OR length("message_attachments"."filename") BETWEEN 1 AND 200

message_attachments_ready_complete.name: message_attachments_ready_complete
message_attachments_ready_complete.value: "message_attachments"."state" <> 'ready' OR ("message_attachments"."storage_key" IS NOT NULL AND "message_attachments"."size_bytes" IS NOT NULL AND "message_attachments"."scan_status" IN ('clean', 'skipped'))

notes_contact_idx.name: notes_contact_idx
notes_contact_idx.where: "notes"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "notes"."contact_id" IS NOT NULL

notes_company_idx.name: notes_company_idx
notes_company_idx.where: "notes"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "notes"."company_id" IS NOT NULL

organizations_platform_standalone.name: organizations_platform_standalone
organizations_platform_standalone.value: "organizations"."kind" <> 'platform' OR ("organizations"."parent_agency_id" IS NULL AND "organizations"."created_by_agency_id" IS NULL)

plans_limits_range.name: plans_limits_range
plans_limits_range.value: ("plans"."max_users" IS NULL OR "plans"."max_users" BETWEEN 1 AND 100000) AND ("plans"."max_connections" IS NULL OR "plans"."max_connections" BETWEEN 1 AND 100000) AND ("plans"."max_queues" IS NULL OR "plans"."max_queues" BETWEEN 1 AND 100000)

queues_greeting_shape.name: queues_greeting_shape
queues_greeting_shape.value: "queues"."greeting_text" IS NULL OR length(btrim("queues"."greeting_text")) BETWEEN 1 AND 1000

response_timers_reassign_idx.name: response_timers_reassign_idx
response_timers_reassign_idx.where: "response_timers"."stopped_at" IS NULL AND "response_timers"."reassign_at" IS NOT NULL

response_timers_response_pair.name: response_timers_response_pair
response_timers_response_pair.value: ("response_timers"."response_seconds" IS NOT NULL) = ("response_timers"."stop_reason" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'human_reply')

sale_payments_shape.name: sale_payments_shape
sale_payments_shape.value: ("sale_payments"."kind" = 'payment' AND "sale_payments"."method" IS NOT NULL) OR ("sale_payments"."kind" = 'correction' AND "sale_payments"."reason" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("sale_payments"."reason")) BETWEEN 1 AND 500)

sale_payments_note_len.name: sale_payments_note_len
sale_payments_note_len.value: "sale_payments"."note" IS NULL OR length("sale_payments"."note") BETWEEN 1 AND 500

sale_status_history_status_valid.name: sale_status_history_status_valid
sale_status_history_status_valid.value: "sale_status_history"."to_status" IN ('active', 'cancelled') AND ("sale_status_history"."from_status" IS NULL OR "sale_status_history"."from_status" IN ('active', 'cancelled'))

sales_note_len.name: sales_note_len
sales_note_len.value: "sales"."note" IS NULL OR length("sales"."note") BETWEEN 1 AND 500

sales_cancel_consistent.name: sales_cancel_consistent
sales_cancel_consistent.value: ("sales"."status" = 'cancelled') = ("sales"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL AND "sales"."cancelled_by" IS NOT NULL AND "sales"."cancel_reason" IS NOT NULL)

sales_cancel_reason_len.name: sales_cancel_reason_len
sales_cancel_reason_len.value: "sales"."cancel_reason" IS NULL OR length(btrim("sales"."cancel_reason")) BETWEEN 1 AND 500

tasks_contact_idx.name: tasks_contact_idx
tasks_contact_idx.where: "tasks"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "tasks"."contact_id" IS NOT NULL

tasks_company_idx.name: tasks_company_idx
tasks_company_idx.where: "tasks"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "tasks"."company_id" IS NOT NULL

trial_config_ranges.name: trial_config_ranges
trial_config_ranges.value: "trial_config"."days" BETWEEN 1 AND 90 AND "trial_config"."extension_days" BETWEEN 1 AND 30 AND "trial_config"."retention_days" BETWEEN 1 AND 365 AND "trial_config"."welcome_credits" >= 0

trials_ext_reason_len.name: trials_ext_reason_len
trials_ext_reason_len.value: "trials"."ext_reason" IS NULL OR length(btrim("trials"."ext_reason")) BETWEEN 10 AND 500

trials_ext_consistent.name: trials_ext_consistent
trials_ext_consistent.value:
("trials"."ext_status" = 'none' AND "trials"."ext_reason" IS NULL AND "trials"."ext_requested_at" IS NULL AND "trials"."ext_decided_by" IS NULL AND "trials"."ext_decided_at" IS NULL AND "trials"."ext_days_granted" IS NULL)
        OR ("trials"."ext_status" = 'pending' AND "trials"."ext_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "trials"."ext_requested_at" IS NOT NULL AND "trials"."ext_decided_by" IS NULL AND "trials"."ext_decided_at" IS NULL AND "trials"."ext_days_granted" IS NULL)
        OR ("trials"."ext_status" = 'approved' AND "trials"."ext_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "trials"."ext_requested_at" IS NOT NULL AND "trials"."ext_decided_by" IS NOT NULL AND "trials"."ext_decided_at" IS NOT NULL AND "trials"."ext_days_granted" > 0)
        OR ("trials"."ext_status" = 'denied' AND "trials"."ext_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "trials"."ext_requested_at" IS NOT NULL AND "trials"."ext_decided_by" IS NOT NULL AND "trials"."ext_decided_at" IS NOT NULL AND "trials"."ext_days_granted" IS NULL)

users_full_name_len.name: users_full_name_len
users_full_name_len.value: "users"."full_name" IS NULL OR length(btrim("users"."full_name")) BETWEEN 2 AND 100
